text_en: While Israel was staying at Shittim, the people began to have sexual relations with the women of Moab.
text_cn: 当以色列人住在史廷的时候，民众开始与摩阿布女子行淫。

text_en: These invited the people to the sacrifices of their gods, and the people ate and bowed down to their gods.
text_cn: 这些女子请民众参与她们神祇（qí）的祭祀；民众吃了供物，且朝拜了她们的神祇。

text_en: Thus Israel yoked itself to the Baal of Peor, and the Lord ’s anger was kindled against Israel.
text_cn: 这样以色列人就归依了巴耳培敖尔，上主因此对以色列大发忿怒。

text_en: The Lord said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and impale them in the sun before the Lord , in order that the fierce anger of the Lord may turn away from Israel. ”
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“你捉住民众中所有的罪魁，在光天化日之下，为上主将他们悬挂起来，好挽回上主对以色列的怒火。”

text_en: And Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Each of you shall kill any of your people who have yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟就吩咐以色列的各首长说：“你们每人应将自己家中归依巴耳培敖尔的人杀死。”

text_en: Just then one of the Israelites came and brought a Midianite woman into his family, in the sight of Moses and in the sight of the whole congregation of the Israelites, while they were weeping at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
text_cn: 看，当梅瑟和以色列子民全会众都在会幕门口流泪痛哭时，以色列子民中正有一人，当着他们的面，带了一个米德杨女人到他兄弟那里去。

text_en: When Phinehas son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he got up and left the congregation. Taking a spear in his hand,
text_cn: 大司祭亚郎的儿子厄肋阿匝尔的儿子丕乃哈斯一见，就由会众中起来，顺手拿了一把长枪，

text_en: he went after the Israelite man into the tent, and pierced the two of them, the Israelite and the woman, through the belly. So the plague was stopped among the people of Israel.
text_cn: 跟那以色列人进入卧室内，刺穿了他们两人，即那以色列人和那女人的肚腹；以色列子民间的灾祸遂止息了。

text_en: Nevertheless those that died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.
text_cn: 在这次灾祸内，死去了二万四千人。

text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
“Phinehas son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, has turned back my wrath from the Israelites by manifesting such zeal among them on my behalf that in my jealousy I did not consume the Israelites.
text_cn: “大司祭亚郎的孙子，厄肋阿匝尔的儿子丕乃哈斯，由以色列子民身上挽回了我的忿怒，因为他在他们中，怀着与我同样的嫉邪的心，因此我没有因我嫉邪之心消灭了以色列子民。

text_en: Therefore say, ‘I hereby grant him my covenant of peace.
text_cn: 为此你应声明：看，我与他结平安的盟约。

text_en: It shall be for him and for his descendants after him a covenant of perpetual priesthood, because he was zealous for his God, and made atonement for the Israelites. ’”
text_cn: 这为他和他的后裔，是永享司祭品位的盟约，因为他为了自己天主的原故，嫉恶如仇，赔补了以色列子民的罪。”

text_en: The name of the slain Israelite man, who was killed with the Midianite woman, was Zimri son of Salu, head of an ancestral house belonging to the Simeonites.
text_cn: 那与米德杨女人一同被杀的以色列人，名叫齐默黎，是撒路的儿子，西默盎家族的族长。

text_en: The name of the Midianite woman who was killed was Cozbi daughter of Zur, who was the head of a clan, an ancestral house in Midian.
text_cn: 那被杀的米德杨女人，名叫苛次彼，是族尔的女儿；族尔是米德杨族一部落的酋长。
“你应围攻米德杨人，打击他们，

text_en: for they have harassed you by the trickery with which they deceived you in the affair of Peor, and in the affair of Cozbi, the daughter of a leader of Midian, their sister; she was killed on the day of the plague that resulted from Peor. ”
text_cn: 因为他们用诡计打击了你们，就是在培敖尔的事上，并在他们的姊妹，米德杨酋长的女儿苛次彼的事上，欺骗了你们。──这女子已在培敖尔的事上，在灾祸之日被杀。”
